rules.sentence: Leiomyomata demonstrate mild cytologic atypia, no tumor cell necrosis, and the mitotic activity is usually <5 mitotic figures per 10 high-power fields (hpf) in the most mitotically active areas.

Leiomyosarcomas demonstrate at least 2 of the following features: a mitotic index of at least 10 mitotic figures per 10 hpf, moderate to severe cytologic atypia, or the presence of tumor cell necrosis, also known as coagulative necrosis.[37]
